sizing.entry: 2 tranches over ~6 weeks: half now, half after the Oct 27-30 hyperscaler capex guides and the Nov 17 Q3 FY27 print (both events have now passed; sizing runs on the combined distribution, allocate.py)
sizing.overlap: AVGO (same AI-accelerator and hyperscaler-capex driver; a direct competitor for the same budgets), GOOGL (a top customer whose capex is NVDA revenue and whose TPU competes), VST (AI data-center power, same capex cycle). About $1.46k of ~$2.34k invested already rides AI capex.
sizing.reason: Fact-checks found no thesis problem, and compression is mostly priced in (19.5x NTM at the 10-05 base; 15.09x calendar NTM at the 2026-10-23 close, 14.80x ex-SBC). But the downside scenario (2027-28 capex digestion with an EPS cut to ~12x) hits AVGO, GOOGL and VST at the same time, so ~5% (~$500) caps the AI-capex cluster at about a fifth of the portfolio. Liquidity is unlimited and there are no lock-up or listing issues. Event risk is concentrated in late October and mid-November, hence the staged entry. P(Sharpe beats SPY) is 0.47: an expected ~+11% at the 10-05 spot (now +27.2% to the live 197.70 research target (12m) at the 2026-11-17 close of 155.46 (Twelve Data): 197.70 / 155.46 - 1; earlier 204.16 (model update 2026-11-17) and 231.51 at the 10-23 close of 210.96 (+9.7%), after the self-funded hyperscaler carve-out 2026-11-16 (231.45) and the gate's fcf_conv recompute; 222.19 (close re-mark 2026-11-12 5:40pm ET, +5.3%), 206.47 (resignation booking 9:26am ET); 213.65 (second gate fix 2026-11-12, +1.3%), 209.11 (Huang-removal card 2026-11-12 01:53Z, -0.9%), the +10.0% to 232.06 (2026-11-10) and the 273.45 and 262.70 quoted earlier were superseded sets) at 38% vol gives a Sharpe of ~0.18-0.2, about the same as SPY's, so there is no clear edge. The 0.47 Sharpe-beat probability and the "low" label are the 10-05 base round's and were not re-scored in this peer-refresh update; sizing itself runs on the combined distribution (allocate.py), not on this text.
sizing.conviction_label_reason: Old scale. The Sharpe-beat probability of 0.47 is essentially no edge. Round-2 checks confirmed the fundamentals but added nothing that raises expected return, the ladder is unchanged from the agents' mean, and the AI-capex overlap with AVGO, GOOGL and VST adds concentration rather than diversification.

drivers.derivation: Post-print 2026-11-17 (Q3 FY27 results release [src 143]): Q3 FY27 reported 8,218 (total $115,844M less Data Center $107,626M; release: Edge $8.2B, +14% q/q, +42% y/y, RTX Spark laptops now shipping from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft Surface and MSI; DGX Spark 64GB [src 143]); our 7,923 was 3.6% low. Q4 FY27 8,850 = 14 weeks at NVIDIA's reported Aug-Oct 2026 Edge sales of $632.2M a week: the 14th week is calendar; within the quarter RTX Spark laptops have their first full quarter (up) while IDC sees Q4-26 PC units -20% y/y on the memory shortage (down) [src 83], and no source nets the two (flagged; the FY24-FY26 Q4 shape gives 8,554, sized). FY28-FY29 chained from Q4 FY27 (Kilian 2026-11-18: the Q4 quarter 'should be informing the path ahead of it'; gaming and non-gaming rates from Kilian's cards 2026-11-12 05:35Z / 05:48Z): Q4 FY27 on 13 weeks, 8,850.2 x 13/14 = 8,218.0, is the run rate Edge enters FY28 with. Q4 FY28 is that quarter a year on, with gaming (72.3% of FY26 Edge: 16,042 / 22,201, 10-K revenue by market [src 191, 97]) at IDC's 2026 PC unit decline -11.3% with no further ASP rise and non-gaming +27% (Edge's Q2 FY27 growth, Blackwell workstations [src 14]): 8,218.0 x (0.723 x 0.887 + 0.277 x 1.27) = 8,161.2; the other FY28 quarters follow the FY24-FY26 mean quarter shares (22.25/24.60/27.05/26.10%), so FY28 = 8,161.2 / 0.2610 = 31,271.9 (+2.1% on the 14-week FY27) and FY29 = each FY28 component grown again = 31,980.9 (+2.3%). The economics: Q4 is the latest quarter and the holiday quarter, so its level (RTX Spark's first full quarter against IDC's Q4 PC fall) is the base the FY28 holiday quarter grows from: a lower Q4 means a lower FY28-29 Edge path. This is not a carried ratio: Q4 FY27 is a forecast, and FY28 comes from its level times the booked gaming and non-gaming drivers, with a multi-year (FY24-FY26) quarter shape (rule 9). Under the supply floor FY28 total revenue stays at $725.0B, so a change in FY28 Edge moves the floor factor k the other way and that k carries into FY29 Data Center. PREVIOUS (to 2026-11-18): FY28 30,423.5 / FY29 31,113.3 on the FY27 total, which left the Q4 basis with no bearing on the path. Review: Q3's +42% y/y despite IDC's falling PC units says the gaming decline premise is weak for FY27, and the Q3 CFO commentary (read via MarketScreener [src 149]) gives no Gaming line, only Edge Computing: 'Strong Blackwell workstation sales and edge compute for Physical AI applications drove the increases', while 'higher memory and system prices continue to affect consumer PC demand'; IDC's Q3 2026 PC units fell 20.1% y/y [src 158]; FY28-29 kept as owner-decided, alternatives re-sized.

drivers.label: Supply-commitment floor factor on Data Center (FY28-29)
drivers.source: Kilian card 2026-11-18 (cmsg_01HdhANNPxz1f5xqDwR22cfLQWzeeQNUThJm3dg7Ryc3dU, 'Floor as a level (FY28-29)'); calibration [src 189]; FY28 commitments $203B [src 149].
drivers.derivation: Booked 2026-11-18 by Kilian's pick 'Floor as a level (FY28-29)'. Rule: k = max(1, (FY28 floor - FY28 Edge) / FY28 Data Center as built), floor = FY28 supply commitments $203B / (1 - 0.72 FY28 gross margin) = $725.0B of FY28 revenue; the same k on every FY28 and FY29 quarter (the build's FY28 shortfall to committed supply is unnamed buyers, read as a level). Now k = (725,000 - 31,272) / 543,132 = 1.2773 (FY28 Edge chained from Q4 FY27 since 2026-11-18; was (725,000 - 30,423) / 543,132 = 1.2788). Evidence: at each Q3, next-FY commitments + inventory + prepaid supply / next-FY cost of revenue = 0.62 FY23, 0.51 FY24, 0.55 FY25, 0.49 FY26 (0.52 ex the H20 charge), never above 1 [src 189]. Interaction with dc_mor (plain): Data Center = build x (1 - (1 - hs_self_funded) x dc_mor) x k, and k is set on the build AFTER the moratorium haircut, so FY28 revenue is the floor whatever dc_mor is. By Kilian's pick this overrides the owner card's no-redirect assumption (2026-11-05) for FY28-29: supply NVIDIA has committed to buy is assumed sold to some buyer even where Texas/PJM builds are paused. Inside FY28 dc_mor now only shapes the quarters (the year total is the floor); in FY29 its haircut still cuts the build, which is then scaled by the same k (FY29 effect of the haircut about -$22.6B x k). Every sized alternative that moves FY28 Data Center recomputes k by the same rule. Scenario deltas move the build with k fixed, so a downside can fall below the floor. FY29 commitments ($92B) are still being placed and set no FY29 floor.

judgment_calls_for_kilian.context: gm FY28 books 0.72, the low end of NVIDIA's 72-73% FY28 range, on 2027 HBM prices potentially +50% (TrendForce [src 69]). The same TrendForce page says NVIDIA plans to raise Vera Rubin and Grace Blackwell server prices by more than 15% in early 2027, and the Q2 FY27 call ties the FY28 recovery to price increases [src 99].
